logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of the 99mTc complexes was evaluated by the “shake flask” method [48]. Briefly, 25 µL of the radiocomplexes were added to a mixture of n-octanol (1 mL) and 0.1 M PBS pH = 7.4 (1 mL), previously saturated in each other by stirring the mixture. This mixture was vortexed and centrifuged (5000 rpm, 10 min, room temperature) to allow phase separation. Aliquots of 50 µL of both octanol and PBS were counted in a gamma counter. The partition coefficient (Po/w) was calculated by dividing the counts in the octanol phase by those in the buffer, and the results expressed as Log Po/w. Log Po/w = -0.75 (99mTc-BBN); Log Po/w = 0.52 (99mTc-TPP); Log Po/w = 0.45 (99mTc-TPP-BBN).
